content: All our baselines as well as TCEN are implemented based on ESPnet BIBREF12, the RNN size is set as $d=1024$ for all models. We use a dropout of 0.3 for embeddings and encoders, and train using Adadelta with initial learning rate of 1.0 for a maximum of 10 epochs.
qasper_evidence_text: All our baselines as well as TCEN are implemented based on ESPnet BIBREF12, the RNN size is set as $d=1024$ for all models. We use a dropout of 0.3 for embeddings and encoders, and train using Adadelta with initial learning rate of 1.0 for a maximum of 10 epochs.
